material_questions.question: Does Binding Snow's ban on taking Energy from the Energy Zone to attach to the Active Pokemon also block Gardevoir Psy Shadow, and is the opponent's zero-Energy Mewtwo promotion under repeated lock fairly characterized as a key resource problem?
material_questions.observed: Binding Snow card text bans Energy Zone attachments to Active during the next opponent turn. Gardevoir Psy Shadow card text takes Psychic from the Energy Zone and attaches to Active. Opponent promotes Mewtwo with zero Energy, then places normal Energy on the Bench. No Psy Shadow activation or failed attempt is observed. Mewtwo never gains Energy or attacks.

evidence.shows: Exact Binding Snow cost and restriction
Active Gardevoir Psy Shadow text before Leaf retreat
Mewtwo Active 150 HP zero Energy; first Gardevoir Bench 1 Psychic
Mewtwo 90 zero Energy; first Gardevoir 2 Psychic
Mewtwo 10 zero Energy; two Gardevoir with 2 and 1 Psychic

material_questions.draft_handling: Causal interaction labeled inference; no observed blocked ability or definite opponent error asserted. Keeping Mewtwo on Bench to receive normal Energy is only a conditional tactical alternative.
material_questions.resolution: Binding Snow prohibits Energy Zone attachments to the Active Pokemon during the next opponent turn, including Psy Shadow. Normal Bench attachments remain legal; existing Energy is not removed. No rejected Psy Shadow attempt or opponent intent is observed.
